summary.notes: 35 tasks across 8 modules. Clean RP spec derived from NC sibling. All cross-file threading rules pass. 2 minor warnings identified — no blockers.

rule_2_itm_in_variants.notes: ITM_PORCH_FLOOR and ITM_PORCH_STEP both appear in spec.json variants.

rule_3_sys_qt_match.notes: Material systems apply_when conditions are compatible with QT2/QT3 spec dimensions.

rule_4_in_consumed.notes: All 9 IN_ inputs consumed by sop_modules tasks or production rates.

rule_5_ps_match.notes: All PS_ keys in production.json match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs.

rule_6_zone_match.notes: All 6 zone_ids in spec.json have matching protection_metadata in sop_modules.json.

rule_7_phase_order.notes: Module phases follow canonical order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> cleanup.

rule_8_uom_consistency.notes: UOM matches between sop_modules.json and production.json for all 35 tasks.

issues.description: Furniture return task (TSK_PFRP_FURNITURE_RETURN) modeled as same-day but noted as potential return visit after 48-72hr cure. Actual scheduling may differ from single-visit estimate model.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable as-is. Furniture return time is included in estimate regardless of when it occurs. Note in estimator guidance that this may be a separate trip.

issues.description: QT2 single-coat variant uses same anti-slip aggregate broadcast but only has one coat to embed it. Aggregate adhesion may be marginally weaker with single coat vs two-coat encapsulation.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable. Single coat still embeds aggregate adequately for light-duty residential porch. QT2 is economy refresh — customer accepts trade-off. Add note to QT2 variant about single-coat aggregate limitation.

phase_values.notes: All phases are setup/prep/prime/apply/cleanup. No 'protect' or 'protection' used.

severity_values.notes: All severities are critical/major/minor. No high/medium/low/WARN.

con_prefix.notes: All consumables use CON_ prefix. No CONS_.

uom_uppercase.notes: All UOM values uppercase: EA, SF, LF, FIXED.

sheen_single_value.notes: Single sheen value 'satin'. No compound values.

porch_floor_rp_specific.notes: All porch floor RP domain requirements addressed. Assessment-first workflow correctly implemented. Substrate branching (concrete vs wood) at task level. No acid etch on RP (RC-004 from research). Anti-slip mandatory. Cure-time communication task included.
